story.kicker: Taha Hüseyinoğlu. The person behind Detoks.
story.title: A person’s choices give a shop its character.
story.lead: A shop in Komotini. What Taha prepares, what he selects from other makers, and a clear distinction between the two.
story.body1: A curiosity that reaches from physiotherapy to plants. At Detoks, Taha Hüseyinoğlu brings together what he prepares himself and what he selects from other producers. Those two shelves shape the character of the shop. Getting to know a product also means getting to know the person who prepared or chose it.
story.heading2: Say what we make. Say what we choose.
story.body2: Taha’s apple vinegar and tarhana share the shop with products from other makers. One person’s work is not presented as another’s. We believe a selection gains character by keeping the people behind each product visible, not by putting our name on everything.
story.body3: Mpizaniou 14, Komotini. A real address where you can visit and ask about a product. This storefront opens the same conversation from further away. Something beside a cup, a new taste in the kitchen, a thoughtful gift. Where the selection belongs in your day is for you to discover.
story.closing: Not grand promises, but a shop you can get to know. A person you can reach when you have a question.

journal.title: Notes from the shop
journal.lead: Getting to know a selection, thinking about a gift, reading a label. Small acts of attention, rather than grand promises.
note1.title: What we look for on a label.
note1.deck: An appealing name cannot replace the details of a product.
note1.body1: Two similar packages can contain different amounts, ingredients or makers. Start with the product name, then read the net quantity, selling unit and producer together. A price per kilogram should not be mistaken for a package price.
note1.body2: Ingredients and allergen information matter when choosing food. On the care shelf, the intended use and labelling deserve their own attention. A product that looks natural is not necessarily suitable for everyone.
note1.body3: We do not present unverified details as complete. Ask us using the product code when information is missing. A photograph is a useful beginning. The product’s identity and label take the decision further.
note2.title: A gift begins with the person.
note2.deck: Less about the size of a box, more about a choice that feels right for someone.
note2.body1: Begin with the person’s everyday life. Do they make time for a long coffee, enjoy finding something for the kitchen, or notice small details of personal care. A few considered products can feel more personal than a box filled at random.
note2.body2: For food gifts, clarify ingredients and allergens. For care products, confirm the intended use. Think about the budget alongside quantities and delivery conditions, not just the number of items.
note2.body3: The gift page lets you choose a starting idea and prepare a note. It does not promise a ready-made box or available stock. Contents, packaging, price and delivery are confirmed in conversation.
note3.title: Getting to know a shop in Komotini.
note3.deck: Being local means more than putting a place name on a label.
note3.body1: A shop may be remembered by its street or by the person you meet inside. For Detoks, Komotini is a real address where that relationship can begin. This online catalogue lets the conversation start from further away.
note3.body2: Separating what Taha prepares from what he selects matters to that local story. Having a shop in Rhodope does not give every item the same origin. Each product deserves to be known through its own information.
note3.body3: This is where the idea of a small business reaching a wider market begins. Without erasing its roots or overstating its capacity. First a clear selection, then verified product and delivery information, followed by relationships built on that foundation.
contact.title: Start with a message.
contact.lead: Product details, a gift idea or a business enquiry. Tell us what you would like to know. The shop’s address and published hours are below.

trade.body: For your café, shop or organisation, share the products you have in mind, approximate quantities and delivery destination. Let us discuss suitable products, quantities and delivery options.

delivery.title: The details before the journey.
delivery.body: For every parcel leaving Komotini, the product and destination conditions must be confirmed together. Reaching Europe is our ambition, not a claim that delivery is already available in every country.
delivery.two: Share the destination country and region.
delivery.three: Confirm the price, packaging and delivery conditions with us.

legal.salesBody: Business identity, required product information, total prices, delivery, returns and applicable contractual terms must be finalised before sales open. This preview explanation does not replace unfinished sales conditions.
